+class OperatorCommandError(RuntimeError):
+    def __init__(self, message: str, exit_code: int = EXIT_UNHEALTHY):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.exit_code = exit_code
+
+
+def _scope(args: Any) -> str:
+    return str(args.account)
+
+
+def _service(name: str) -> Any:
+    service = CLI_SERVICES.get(name)
+    if service is None:
+        raise OperatorCommandError(f"{name}: service is not configured")
+    return service
+
+
+def _invoke(service: Any, operation: str, args: Any) -> Any:
+    method = getattr(service, operation, None)
+    if method is None and callable(service):
+        method = service
+    if method is None:
+        raise OperatorCommandError(f"{operation}: service operation is unavailable")
+    try:
+        return method(scope=_scope(args), scenario=args.scenario, args=args)
+    except TypeError:
+        try:
+            return method(_scope(args), args)
+        except TypeError:
+            return method(_scope(args))
+
+
+def _run_report(name: str, args: Any) -> Any | None:
+    """Use the s.1/s.2 reporting builders against an injected, scope-bound source."""
+    provider = CLI_SERVICES.get("reporting-context")
+    if provider is None:
+        return None
+    context = provider(scope=_scope(args), scenario=args.scenario, args=args)
+    source = context["source"]
+    report_filter = context["report_filter"]
+    from dataclasses import replace
+    from mike_trade.reporting import metrics
+
+    period = getattr(args, "period", "all")
+    report_filter = replace(report_filter, period=period)
+    if name == "report-symbol":
+        report_filter = replace(report_filter, symbol=args.symbol_or_name)
+    elif name == "report-strategy":
+        report_filter = replace(report_filter, buy_strategy=args.symbol_or_name)
+    if name in {"report-pairs"}:
+        return metrics.summarize_by_pair(source, report_filter)
+    if name in {"report-symbol"}:
+        return metrics.summarize_by_symbol(source, report_filter)
+    if name in {"report-strategy"}:
+        return metrics.summarize_by_strategy(source, report_filter)
+    if name == "report-comparison":

+        if compare is None:

+        return metrics.compare_accounts(source, compare, report_filter)

+    if name in {"pause", "resume", "pause-symbol", "resume-symbol", "entries-disable", "entries-enable"}:
+        controls = _service("entry-controls")
+        # These controls affect eligibility of new entries only. They do not
+        # stop fill handling, protection, trailing management or reconciliation.

+            "pause": "pause_entries", "resume": "resume_entries",
+            "pause-symbol": "pause_symbol_entries", "resume-symbol": "resume_symbol_entries",
+            "entries-disable": "disable_entries", "entries-enable": "enable_entries",

@@ -0,0 +1,90 @@
+"""Thin account-scoped position and risk-control routes.
+
+The engine owns serialized command acknowledgement and order coordination.
+The CLI refuses executable actions before submission when its heartbeat is
+missing or stale, so no future intent is queued offline.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from typing import Any
+
+from mike_trade.cli import EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE, EXIT_REFUSED, EXIT_UNHEALTHY, render
+
+POSITION_SERVICES: dict[str, Any] = {}
+
+
+class PositionCommandError(RuntimeError):
+    def __init__(self, message: str, exit_code: int = EXIT_UNHEALTHY):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.exit_code = exit_code
+
+
+def _scope(args: Any) -> str:
+    return str(args.account)
+
+
+def _service(name: str) -> Any:
+    value = POSITION_SERVICES.get(name)
+    if value is None:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name}: service is not configured")
+    return value
+
+
+def _call(method: Any, scope: str, args: Any) -> Any:
+    try:
+        return method(scope=scope, scenario=args.scenario, args=args)
+    except TypeError:
+        try:
+            return method(scope, args)
+        except TypeError:
+            return method(scope)
+
+
+def _engine_command(name: str, args: Any) -> int:
+    engine = _service("engine_control")
+    scope = _scope(args)
+    online = getattr(engine, "is_online", None) or getattr(engine, "is_engine_online", None)
+    if online is None or not bool(online(scope)):
+        print(f"{name} refused: engine heartbeat is absent or stale for the selected account; no command was queued.", file=sys.stderr)
+        return EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE
+    send = getattr(engine, "send_and_wait", None) or getattr(engine, "submit_and_wait", None) or getattr(engine, "send_control", None)
+    if send is None:
+        raise PositionCommandError("engine control channel is unavailable", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE)
+    payload = {"symbol": getattr(args, "symbol_or_name", None), "reason": args.reason,
+               "live_confirmed": getattr(args, "confirm_live", None) == "YES"}
+    try:
+        result = send(name, scope=scope, payload=payload, timeout=getattr(engine, "ack_timeout", 30))
+    except (ConnectionError, TimeoutError) as exc:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name} acknowledgement unavailable: {exc}", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE) from exc
+    if result is False or getattr(result, "acknowledged", True) is False:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name} was not acknowledged by the engine", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE)
+    render(result if result is not None else {"command": name, "account": scope, "status": "acknowledged"}, args.format)
+    return 0
+
+
+def run_operator_command(name: str, args: Any) -> int:
+    if name in {"close", "close-all", "flatten"}:
+        return _engine_command(name, args)
+    service = _service(name)
+    operation = {
+        "positions": "positions", "orders": "orders", "balance": "balance", "budget": "budget",
+        "reconcile": "reconcile", "stop-status": "stop_status", "stops-audit": "stops_audit",
+        "trail-status": "trail_status", "trail-history": "trail_history", "trail-policy-show": "trail_policy_show",
+        "trail-policy-set": "trail_policy_set", "trail-reconcile": "trail_reconcile",
+        "entry-limits": "entry_limits", "entry-limits-reset": "entry_limits_reset", "cooldown-status": "cooldown_status",
+    }[name]
+    method = getattr(service, operation, None)
+    if method is None:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name}: service operation is unavailable")
+    try:
+        result = _call(method, _scope(args), args)
+    except (ConnectionError, TimeoutError) as exc:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name}: service unreachable: {exc}", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE) from exc
+    except Exception as exc:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name}: {exc}") from exc
+    if getattr(result, "ok", True) is False:
+        render(result, args.format)
+        return EXIT_UNHEALTHY
+    render(result, args.format)
+    return 0

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json

+import pytest

+from mike_trade import cli

+
+
+class FrozenClock:
+    def now(self):
+        return datetime(2026, 1, 2, tzinfo=UTC)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def reset_services():
+    cli_commands.CLI_SERVICES.clear()
+    position_commands.POSITION_SERVICES.clear()
+    yield
+    cli_commands.CLI_SERVICES.clear()
+    position_commands.POSITION_SERVICES.clear()
+
+
+def test_every_canonical_command_parses():
+    parser = cli.build_parser()
+    for command in cli.CANONICAL_COMMANDS:
+        assert parser.parse_args([command]).subcommand == command
+
+
+def test_stop_does_not_cancel_or_close(capsys):
+    class Lifecycle:
+        def __init__(self): self.calls = []
+        def stop_engine(self, **kwargs): self.calls.append("stop"); return {"stopped": True}
+        def cancel(self, *a): self.calls.append("cancel")
+        def close(self, *a): self.calls.append("close")
+    lifecycle = Lifecycle()
+    cli_commands.CLI_SERVICES["stop"] = lifecycle
+    assert cli.main(["stop"]) == 0
+    assert lifecycle.calls == ["stop"]
+    assert "remain broker-protected" in capsys.readouterr().out
+
+
+def test_pause_only_changes_entry_eligibility():
+    class EntryControls:
+        def __init__(self): self.calls = []
+        def pause_entries(self, **kwargs): self.calls.append("entries-paused")
+    controls = EntryControls()
+    cli_commands.CLI_SERVICES["entry-controls"] = controls
+    assert cli.main(["pause"]) == 0
+    assert controls.calls == ["entries-paused"]
+
+
+def test_live_close_confirmation_guard_then_env_override(monkeypatch, capsys):
+    class Engine:
+        calls = []
+        def is_online(self, scope): self.calls.append(("online", scope)); return True
+        def send_and_wait(self, name, **kwargs): self.calls.append((name, kwargs["scope"])); return {"ack": True}
+    engine = Engine()
+    position_commands.POSITION_SERVICES["engine_control"] = engine
+    assert cli.main(["--account", "LIVE:acct", "close", "AAPL"]) == 3
+    assert engine.calls == []
+    monkeypatch.setenv("CONFIRM_LIVE", "YES")
+    assert cli.main(["--account", "LIVE:acct", "close", "AAPL"]) == 0
+    assert engine.calls == [("online", "LIVE:acct"), ("close", "LIVE:acct")]
+
+
+def test_risk_reducing_controls_need_no_live_confirmation():
+    calls = []
+    controls = types.SimpleNamespace(
+        disable_entries=lambda **kw: calls.append(("disable", kw["scope"])),
+        disable_live=lambda **kw: calls.append(("live-disable", kw["scope"])),
+    )
+    cli_commands.CLI_SERVICES["entry-controls"] = controls
+    cli_commands.CLI_SERVICES["live-disable"] = controls
+    assert cli.main(["--account", "LIVE:acct", "entries-disable"]) == 0
+    assert cli.main(["--account", "LIVE:acct", "live-disable"]) != 3
+    assert calls[0] == ("disable", "LIVE:acct")
+
+
+def test_offline_close_does_not_write_queued_intent(tmp_path):
+    db = sqlite3.connect(tmp_path / "operator.db")
+    db.execute("create table intents (id integer primary key)")
+    class Engine:
+        def is_online(self, scope): return False
+        def send_and_wait(self, *a, **kw): raise AssertionError("must not send")
+    position_commands.POSITION_SERVICES["engine_control"] = Engine()
+    assert cli.main(["close", "AAPL"]) == 4
+    assert db.execute("select count(*) from intents").fetchone()[0] == 0
+    assert FrozenClock().now().year == 2026
+
+
+def test_live_start_runs_preflight_and_refuses_failure():
+    calls = []
+    class Preflight:
+        def run(self, **kwargs): calls.append("preflight"); return False
+    cli_commands.CLI_SERVICES["live-preflight"] = Preflight()
+    cli_commands.CLI_SERVICES["live-start"] = lambda **kwargs: calls.append("start")
+    assert cli.main(["--account", "LIVE:acct", "--confirm-live", "YES", "live-start"]) == 3
+    assert calls == ["preflight"]
+
+
+def test_account_scope_passed_to_service():
+    seen = []
+    cli_commands.CLI_SERVICES["status"] = lambda **kwargs: seen.append(kwargs["scope"]) or {"ok": True}
+    assert cli.main(["--account", "PAPER:subaccount", "status"]) == 0
+    assert seen == ["PAPER:subaccount"]
+
+
+def test_json_decimal_is_string_and_account_identifier_masked(capsys):
+    cli_commands.CLI_SERVICES["status"] = lambda **kwargs: {
+        "cash": Decimal("12.30"), "account_id": "private-account"
+    }
+    assert cli.main(["status", "--format", "json"]) == 0
+    output = json.loads(capsys.readouterr().out)
+    assert output == {"account_id": "***", "cash": "12.30"}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["signals", "evaluations", "events", "logs", "health"])
+def test_history_commands_are_lazily_routed(monkeypatch, name):
+    module = types.ModuleType("mike_trade.controls.history_commands")
+    calls = []
+    module.run_history_command = lambda command, args: calls.append((command, args.account)) or 0
+    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "mike_trade.controls.history_commands", module)
+    assert cli.main([name]) == 0
+    assert calls == [(name, "SHADOW:default")]

+"""Thin lifecycle, configuration, provider, strategy, mode and reporting CLI routes.
+
+Concrete application services are injected through ``CLI_SERVICES`` by the
+composition root. This module owns argument routing and safety checks only.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from typing import Any
+
+from mike_trade.cli import EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE, EXIT_REFUSED, EXIT_UNHEALTHY, require_live_confirmation, render
+
+CLI_SERVICES: dict[str, Any] = {}
+
+
+class OperatorCommandError(RuntimeError):
+    def __init__(self, message: str, exit_code: int = EXIT_UNHEALTHY):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.exit_code = exit_code
+
+
+def _scope(args: Any) -> str:
+    return str(args.account)
+
+
+def _service(name: str) -> Any:
+    service = CLI_SERVICES.get(name)
+    if service is None:
+        raise OperatorCommandError(f"{name}: service is not configured")
+    return service
+
+
+def _invoke(service: Any, operation: str, args: Any) -> Any:
+    method = getattr(service, operation, None)
+    if method is None and callable(service):
+        method = service
+    if method is None:
+        raise OperatorCommandError(f"{operation}: service operation is unavailable")
+    try:
+        return method(scope=_scope(args), scenario=args.scenario, args=args)
+    except TypeError:
+        try:
+            return method(_scope(args), args)
+        except TypeError:
+            return method(_scope(args))
+
+
+def _run_report(name: str, args: Any) -> Any | None:
+    """Use the s.1/s.2 reporting builders against an injected, scope-bound source."""
+    provider = CLI_SERVICES.get("reporting-context")
+    if provider is None:
+        return None
+    context = provider(scope=_scope(args), scenario=args.scenario, args=args)
+    source = context["source"]
+    report_filter = context["report_filter"]
+    from dataclasses import replace
+    from mike_trade.reporting import metrics
+
+    period = getattr(args, "period", "all")
+    report_filter = replace(report_filter, period=period)
+    if name == "report-symbol":
+        report_filter = replace(report_filter, symbol=args.symbol_or_name)
+    elif name == "report-strategy":
+        report_filter = replace(report_filter, buy_strategy=args.symbol_or_name)
+    if name in {"report-pairs"}:
+        return metrics.summarize_by_pair(source, report_filter)
+    if name in {"report-symbol"}:
+        return metrics.summarize_by_symbol(source, report_filter)
+    if name in {"report-strategy"}:
+        return metrics.summarize_by_strategy(source, report_filter)
+    if name == "report-comparison":
+        compare = context.get("compare_accounts")
+        if compare is None:
+            raise OperatorCommandError("comparison reporting requires two explicitly scoped accounts")
+        return metrics.compare_accounts(source, compare, report_filter)
+    return metrics.build_trade_cycles(source, report_filter)
+
+
+def run_operator_command(name: str, args: Any) -> int:
+    if name in {"pause", "resume", "pause-symbol", "resume-symbol", "entries-disable", "entries-enable"}:
+        controls = _service("entry-controls")
+        # These controls affect eligibility of new entries only. They do not
+        # stop fill handling, protection, trailing management or reconciliation.
+        method_name = {
+            "pause": "pause_entries", "resume": "resume_entries",
+            "pause-symbol": "pause_symbol_entries", "resume-symbol": "resume_symbol_entries",
+            "entries-disable": "disable_entries", "entries-enable": "enable_entries",
+        }[name]
+        result = _invoke(controls, method_name, args)
+        render(result if result is not None else {"command": name, "scope": _scope(args), "effect": "new entries only"}, args.format)
+        return 0
+    if name in {"live-enable", "live-start"}:
+        try:
+            result = _invoke(_service("live-preflight"), "run", args)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            print(f"Live preflight failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
+            return EXIT_REFUSED
+        if result is False or getattr(result, "ok", True) is False:
+            print("Live preflight failed; operation refused.", file=sys.stderr)
+            return EXIT_REFUSED
+    if name == "stop":
+        result = _invoke(_service(name), "stop_engine", args)
+        print("Engine stopped. Open positions remain broker-protected.")
+        if result is not None:
+            render(result, args.format)
+        return 0
+    if name.startswith("report"):
+        try:
+            report = _run_report(name, args)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            raise OperatorCommandError(f"{name}: {exc}") from exc
+        if report is not None:
+            if name == "report-export":
+                from mike_trade.reporting.export import export_json
+                export_json(report, "trade_cycles", getattr(args, "output_path", None))
+                print(f"Exported report to {args.output_path}" if args.output_path else "Report export rendered.")
+            else:
+                render(report, args.format)
+            return 0
+    service = _service(name)
+    # Explicit operation mapping avoids converting CLI names into business logic.
+    operation = {
+        "start": "start_engine", "restart": "restart_engine", "status": "status",
+        "doctor": "doctor", "config-show": "show_config", "providers": "list_providers",
+        "provider-check": "check_provider", "broker-check": "check_broker", "data-check": "check_data",
+        "strategies": "list_strategies", "strategy-info": "strategy_info", "strategy-check": "check_strategy",
+        "strategy-enable": "enable_strategy", "strategy-disable": "disable_strategy", "strategy-set": "set_strategy",
+        "symbols": "list_symbols", "symbols-add": "add_symbols", "symbols-remove": "remove_symbols",
+        "symbols-enable": "enable_symbols", "symbols-disable": "disable_symbols",
+        "dashboard": "dashboard_status", "dashboard-start": "start_dashboard", "dashboard-stop": "stop_dashboard", "dashboard-health": "dashboard_health",
+        "shadow-start": "start_shadow", "shadow-stop": "stop_shadow", "shadow-list": "list_scenarios", "shadow-create": "create_scenario", "shadow-reset": "reset_scenario",
+        "paper-start": "start_paper", "paper-stop": "stop_paper", "paper-status": "paper_status",
+        "live-preflight": "run", "live-enable": "enable_live", "live-start": "start_live", "live-disable": "disable_live",
+        "report": "report", "report-daily": "report_daily", "report-symbol": "report_symbol", "report-strategy": "report_strategy",
+        "report-pairs": "report_pairs", "report-shadow": "report_shadow", "report-comparison": "report_comparison", "report-export": "report_export",
+        "backtest": "run_backtest", "backtest-status": "backtest_status", "backtest-report": "backtest_report", "backtest-list": "backtest_list",
+        "cache-status": "cache_status", "cache-refresh": "cache_refresh", "db-check": "db_check", "db-backup": "db_backup", "db-restore-dry-run": "db_restore_dry_run",
+        "service-install": "service_install", "service-uninstall": "service_uninstall", "service-status": "service_status",
+    }[name]
+    try:
+        result = _invoke(service, operation, args)
+    except (ConnectionError, TimeoutError) as exc:
+        raise OperatorCommandError(f"{name}: service unreachable: {exc}", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE) from exc
+    except Exception as exc:
+        raise OperatorCommandError(f"{name}: {exc}") from exc
+    if name.endswith("-check") or name in {"doctor", "live-preflight", "dashboard-health", "db-check"}:
+        if result is False or getattr(result, "ok", True) is False:
+            render(result, args.format)
+            return EXIT_UNHEALTHY
+    render(result, args.format)
+    return 0

+"""Thin account-scoped position and risk-control routes.
+
+The engine owns serialized command acknowledgement and order coordination.
+The CLI refuses executable actions before submission when its heartbeat is
+missing or stale, so no future intent is queued offline.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from typing import Any
+
+from mike_trade.cli import EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE, EXIT_REFUSED, EXIT_UNHEALTHY, render
+
+POSITION_SERVICES: dict[str, Any] = {}
+
+
+class PositionCommandError(RuntimeError):
+    def __init__(self, message: str, exit_code: int = EXIT_UNHEALTHY):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.exit_code = exit_code
+
+
+def _scope(args: Any) -> str:
+    return str(args.account)
+
+
+def _service(name: str) -> Any:
+    value = POSITION_SERVICES.get(name)
+    if value is None:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name}: service is not configured")
+    return value
+
+
+def _call(method: Any, scope: str, args: Any) -> Any:
+    try:
+        return method(scope=scope, scenario=args.scenario, args=args)
+    except TypeError:
+        try:
+            return method(scope, args)
+        except TypeError:
+            return method(scope)
+
+
+def _engine_command(name: str, args: Any) -> int:
+    engine = _service("engine_control")
+    scope = _scope(args)
+    online = getattr(engine, "is_online", None) or getattr(engine, "is_engine_online", None)
+    if online is None or not bool(online(scope)):
+        print(f"{name} refused: engine heartbeat is absent or stale for the selected account; no command was queued.", file=sys.stderr)
+        return EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE
+    send = getattr(engine, "send_and_wait", None) or getattr(engine, "submit_and_wait", None) or getattr(engine, "send_control", None)
+    if send is None:
+        raise PositionCommandError("engine control channel is unavailable", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE)
+    payload = {"symbol": getattr(args, "symbol_or_name", None), "reason": args.reason,
+               "live_confirmed": getattr(args, "confirm_live", None) == "YES"}
+    try:
+        result = send(name, scope=scope, payload=payload, timeout=getattr(engine, "ack_timeout", 30))
+    except (ConnectionError, TimeoutError) as exc:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name} acknowledgement unavailable: {exc}", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE) from exc
+    if result is False or getattr(result, "acknowledged", True) is False:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name} was not acknowledged by the engine", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE)
+    render(result if result is not None else {"command": name, "account": scope, "status": "acknowledged"}, args.format)
+    return 0
+
+
+def run_operator_command(name: str, args: Any) -> int:
+    if name in {"close", "close-all", "flatten"}:
+        return _engine_command(name, args)
+    service = _service(name)
+    operation = {
+        "positions": "positions", "orders": "orders", "balance": "balance", "budget": "budget",
+        "reconcile": "reconcile", "stop-status": "stop_status", "stops-audit": "stops_audit",
+        "trail-status": "trail_status", "trail-history": "trail_history", "trail-policy-show": "trail_policy_show",
+        "trail-policy-set": "trail_policy_set", "trail-reconcile": "trail_reconcile",
+        "entry-limits": "entry_limits", "entry-limits-reset": "entry_limits_reset", "cooldown-status": "cooldown_status",
+    }[name]
+    method = getattr(service, operation, None)
+    if method is None:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name}: service operation is unavailable")
+    try:
+        result = _call(method, _scope(args), args)
+    except (ConnectionError, TimeoutError) as exc:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name}: service unreachable: {exc}", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE) from exc
+    except Exception as exc:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name}: {exc}") from exc
+    if getattr(result, "ok", True) is False:
+        render(result, args.format)
+        return EXIT_UNHEALTHY
+    render(result, args.format)
+    return 0

+
+
+def test_stop_does_not_cancel_or_close(capsys):
+    class Lifecycle:
+        def __init__(self): self.calls = []
+        def stop_engine(self, **kwargs): self.calls.append("stop"); return {"stopped": True}
+        def cancel(self, *a): self.calls.append("cancel")
+        def close(self, *a): self.calls.append("close")
+    lifecycle = Lifecycle()
+    cli_commands.CLI_SERVICES["stop"] = lifecycle
+    assert cli.main(["stop"]) == 0
+    assert lifecycle.calls == ["stop"]
+    assert "remain broker-protected" in capsys.readouterr().out
+
+

+    class EntryControls:
+        def __init__(self): self.calls = []
+        def pause_entries(self, **kwargs): self.calls.append("entries-paused")
+    controls = EntryControls()
+    cli_commands.CLI_SERVICES["entry-controls"] = controls
+    assert cli.main(["pause"]) == 0
+    assert controls.calls == ["entries-paused"]

+"""Thin lifecycle, configuration, provider, strategy, mode and reporting CLI routes.
+
+Concrete application services are injected through ``CLI_SERVICES`` by the
+composition root. This module owns argument routing and safety checks only.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from typing import Any
+
+from mike_trade.cli import EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE, EXIT_REFUSED, EXIT_UNHEALTHY, require_live_confirmation, render
+
+CLI_SERVICES: dict[str, Any] = {}
+
+
+class OperatorCommandError(RuntimeError):
+    def __init__(self, message: str, exit_code: int = EXIT_UNHEALTHY):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.exit_code = exit_code
+
+
+def _scope(args: Any) -> str:
+    return str(args.account)
+
+
+def _service(name: str) -> Any:
+    service = CLI_SERVICES.get(name)
+    if service is None:
+        raise OperatorCommandError(f"{name}: service is not configured")
+    return service
+
+
+def _invoke(service: Any, operation: str, args: Any) -> Any:
+    method = getattr(service, operation, None)
+    if method is None and callable(service):
+        method = service
+    if method is None:
+        raise OperatorCommandError(f"{operation}: service operation is unavailable")
+    try:
+        return method(scope=_scope(args), scenario=args.scenario, args=args)
+    except TypeError:
+        try:
+            return method(_scope(args), args)
+        except TypeError:
+            return method(_scope(args))
+
+
+def _run_report(name: str, args: Any) -> Any | None:
+    """Use the s.1/s.2 reporting builders against an injected, scope-bound source."""
+    provider = CLI_SERVICES.get("reporting-context")
+    if provider is None:
+        return None
+    context = provider(scope=_scope(args), scenario=args.scenario, args=args)
+    source = context["source"]
+    report_filter = context["report_filter"]
+    from dataclasses import replace
+    from mike_trade.reporting import metrics
+
+    period = getattr(args, "period", "all")
+    report_filter = replace(report_filter, period=period)
+    if name == "report-symbol":
+        report_filter = replace(report_filter, symbol=args.symbol_or_name)
+    elif name == "report-strategy":
+        report_filter = replace(report_filter, buy_strategy=args.symbol_or_name)
+    if name in {"report-pairs"}:
+        return metrics.summarize_by_pair(source, report_filter)
+    if name in {"report-symbol"}:
+        return metrics.summarize_by_symbol(source, report_filter)
+    if name in {"report-strategy"}:
+        return metrics.summarize_by_strategy(source, report_filter)
+    if name == "report-comparison":
+        compare = context.get("compare_accounts")
+        if compare is None:
+            raise OperatorCommandError("comparison reporting requires two explicitly scoped accounts")
+        return metrics.compare_accounts(source, compare, report_filter)
+    return metrics.build_trade_cycles(source, report_filter)
+
+

+"""Thin account-scoped position and risk-control routes.
+
+The engine owns serialized command acknowledgement and order coordination.
+The CLI refuses executable actions before submission when its heartbeat is
+missing or stale, so no future intent is queued offline.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from typing import Any
+
+from mike_trade.cli import EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE, EXIT_REFUSED, EXIT_UNHEALTHY, render
+
+POSITION_SERVICES: dict[str, Any] = {}
+
+
+class PositionCommandError(RuntimeError):
+    def __init__(self, message: str, exit_code: int = EXIT_UNHEALTHY):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.exit_code = exit_code
+
+
+def _scope(args: Any) -> str:
+    return str(args.account)
+
+
+def _service(name: str) -> Any:
+    value = POSITION_SERVICES.get(name)
+    if value is None:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name}: service is not configured")
+    return value
+
+
+def _call(method: Any, scope: str, args: Any) -> Any:
+    try:
+        return method(scope=scope, scenario=args.scenario, args=args)
+    except TypeError:
+        try:
+            return method(scope, args)
+        except TypeError:
+            return method(scope)
+
+

+"""Thin lifecycle, configuration, provider, strategy, mode and reporting CLI routes.
+
+Concrete application services are injected through ``CLI_SERVICES`` by the
+composition root. This module owns argument routing and safety checks only.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from typing import Any
+
+from mike_trade.cli import EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE, EXIT_REFUSED, EXIT_UNHEALTHY, require_live_confirmation, render
+
+CLI_SERVICES: dict[str, Any] = {}
+
+
+class OperatorCommandError(RuntimeError):
+    def __init__(self, message: str, exit_code: int = EXIT_UNHEALTHY):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.exit_code = exit_code
+
+
+def _scope(args: Any) -> str:
+    return str(args.account)
+
+
+def _service(name: str) -> Any:
+    service = CLI_SERVICES.get(name)
+    if service is None:
+        raise OperatorCommandError(f"{name}: service is not configured")
+    return service
+
+
+def _invoke(service: Any, operation: str, args: Any) -> Any:
+    method = getattr(service, operation, None)
+    if method is None and callable(service):
+        method = service
+    if method is None:
+        raise OperatorCommandError(f"{operation}: service operation is unavailable")
+    try:
+        return method(scope=_scope(args), scenario=args.scenario, args=args)
+    except TypeError:
+        try:
+            return method(_scope(args), args)
+        except TypeError:
+            return method(_scope(args))
+
+
+def _run_report(name: str, args: Any) -> Any | None:
+    """Use the s.1/s.2 reporting builders against an injected, scope-bound source."""
+    provider = CLI_SERVICES.get("reporting-context")
+    if provider is None:
+        return None
+    context = provider(scope=_scope(args), scenario=args.scenario, args=args)
+    source = context["source"]
+    report_filter = context["report_filter"]
+    from dataclasses import replace
+    from mike_trade.reporting import metrics
+
+    period = getattr(args, "period", "all")
+    report_filter = replace(report_filter, period=period)
+    if name == "report-symbol":
+        report_filter = replace(report_filter, symbol=args.symbol_or_name)
+    elif name == "report-strategy":
+        report_filter = replace(report_filter, buy_strategy=args.symbol_or_name)
+    if name in {"report-pairs"}:
+        return metrics.summarize_by_pair(source, report_filter)
+    if name in {"report-symbol"}:
+        return metrics.summarize_by_symbol(source, report_filter)
+    if name in {"report-strategy"}:
+        return metrics.summarize_by_strategy(source, report_filter)
+    if name == "report-comparison":
+        compare = context.get("compare_accounts")
+        if compare is None:
+            raise OperatorCommandError("comparison reporting requires two explicitly scoped accounts")
+        return metrics.compare_accounts(source, compare, report_filter)
+    return metrics.build_trade_cycles(source, report_filter)
+
+
+def run_operator_command(name: str, args: Any) -> int:
+    if name in {"pause", "resume", "pause-symbol", "resume-symbol", "entries-disable", "entries-enable"}:
+        controls = _service("entry-controls")
+        # These controls affect eligibility of new entries only. They do not
+        # stop fill handling, protection, trailing management or reconciliation.
+        method_name = {
+            "pause": "pause_entries", "resume": "resume_entries",
+            "pause-symbol": "pause_symbol_entries", "resume-symbol": "resume_symbol_entries",
+            "entries-disable": "disable_entries", "entries-enable": "enable_entries",
+        }[name]
+        result = _invoke(controls, method_name, args)
+        render(result if result is not None else {"command": name, "scope": _scope(args), "effect": "new entries only"}, args.format)
+        return 0
+    if name in {"live-enable", "live-start"}:
+        try:
+            result = _invoke(_service("live-preflight"), "run", args)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            print(f"Live preflight failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
+            return EXIT_REFUSED
+        if result is False or getattr(result, "ok", True) is False:
+            print("Live preflight failed; operation refused.", file=sys.stderr)
+            return EXIT_REFUSED
+    if name == "stop":
+        result = _invoke(_service(name), "stop_engine", args)
+        print("Engine stopped. Open positions remain broker-protected.")
+        if result is not None:
+            render(result, args.format)
+        return 0
+    if name.startswith("report"):
+        try:
+            report = _run_report(name, args)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            raise OperatorCommandError(f"{name}: {exc}") from exc
+        if report is not None:
+            if name == "report-export":
+                from mike_trade.reporting.export import export_json
+                export_json(report, "trade_cycles", getattr(args, "output_path", None))
+                print(f"Exported report to {args.output_path}" if args.output_path else "Report export rendered.")
+            else:
+                render(report, args.format)
+            return 0
+    service = _service(name)
+    # Explicit operation mapping avoids converting CLI names into business logic.
+    operation = {
+        "start": "start_engine", "restart": "restart_engine", "status": "status",
+        "doctor": "doctor", "config-show": "show_config", "providers": "list_providers",
+        "provider-check": "check_provider", "broker-check": "check_broker", "data-check": "check_data",
+        "strategies": "list_strategies", "strategy-info": "strategy_info", "strategy-check": "check_strategy",
+        "strategy-enable": "enable_strategy", "strategy-disable": "disable_strategy", "strategy-set": "set_strategy",
+        "symbols": "list_symbols", "symbols-add": "add_symbols", "symbols-remove": "remove_symbols",
+        "symbols-enable": "enable_symbols", "symbols-disable": "disable_symbols",
+        "dashboard": "dashboard_status", "dashboard-start": "start_dashboard", "dashboard-stop": "stop_dashboard", "dashboard-health": "dashboard_health",
+        "shadow-start": "start_shadow", "shadow-stop": "stop_shadow", "shadow-list": "list_scenarios", "shadow-create": "create_scenario", "shadow-reset": "reset_scenario",
+        "paper-start": "start_paper", "paper-stop": "stop_paper", "paper-status": "paper_status",
+        "live-preflight": "run", "live-enable": "enable_live", "live-start": "start_live", "live-disable": "disable_live",
+        "report": "report", "report-daily": "report_daily", "report-symbol": "report_symbol", "report-strategy": "report_strategy",
+        "report-pairs": "report_pairs", "report-shadow": "report_shadow", "report-comparison": "report_comparison", "report-export": "report_export",
+        "backtest": "run_backtest", "backtest-status": "backtest_status", "backtest-report": "backtest_report", "backtest-list": "backtest_list",
+        "cache-status": "cache_status", "cache-refresh": "cache_refresh", "db-check": "db_check", "db-backup": "db_backup", "db-restore-dry-run": "db_restore_dry_run",
+        "service-install": "service_install", "service-uninstall": "service_uninstall", "service-status": "service_status",
+    }[name]
+    try:
+        result = _invoke(service, operation, args)
+    except (ConnectionError, TimeoutError) as exc:
+        raise OperatorCommandError(f"{name}: service unreachable: {exc}", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE) from exc
+    except Exception as exc:
+        raise OperatorCommandError(f"{name}: {exc}") from exc
+    if name.endswith("-check") or name in {"doctor", "live-preflight", "dashboard-health", "db-check"}:
+        if result is False or getattr(result, "ok", True) is False:
+            render(result, args.format)
+            return EXIT_UNHEALTHY
+    render(result, args.format)
+    return 0

+"""Thin account-scoped position and risk-control routes.
+
+The engine owns serialized command acknowledgement and order coordination.
+The CLI refuses executable actions before submission when its heartbeat is
+missing or stale, so no future intent is queued offline.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from typing import Any
+
+from mike_trade.cli import EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE, EXIT_REFUSED, EXIT_UNHEALTHY, render
+
+POSITION_SERVICES: dict[str, Any] = {}
+
+
+class PositionCommandError(RuntimeError):
+    def __init__(self, message: str, exit_code: int = EXIT_UNHEALTHY):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.exit_code = exit_code
+
+
+def _scope(args: Any) -> str:
+    return str(args.account)
+
+
+def _service(name: str) -> Any:
+    value = POSITION_SERVICES.get(name)
+    if value is None:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name}: service is not configured")
+    return value
+
+
+def _call(method: Any, scope: str, args: Any) -> Any:
+    try:
+        return method(scope=scope, scenario=args.scenario, args=args)
+    except TypeError:
+        try:
+            return method(scope, args)
+        except TypeError:
+            return method(scope)
+
+
+def _engine_command(name: str, args: Any) -> int:
+    engine = _service("engine_control")
+    scope = _scope(args)
+    online = getattr(engine, "is_online", None) or getattr(engine, "is_engine_online", None)
+    if online is None or not bool(online(scope)):
+        print(f"{name} refused: engine heartbeat is absent or stale for the selected account; no command was queued.", file=sys.stderr)
+        return EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE
+    send = getattr(engine, "send_and_wait", None) or getattr(engine, "submit_and_wait", None) or getattr(engine, "send_control", None)
+    if send is None:
+        raise PositionCommandError("engine control channel is unavailable", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE)
+    payload = {"symbol": getattr(args, "symbol_or_name", None), "reason": args.reason,
+               "live_confirmed": getattr(args, "confirm_live", None) == "YES"}
+    try:
+        result = send(name, scope=scope, payload=payload, timeout=getattr(engine, "ack_timeout", 30))
+    except (ConnectionError, TimeoutError) as exc:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name} acknowledgement unavailable: {exc}", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE) from exc
+    if result is False or getattr(result, "acknowledged", True) is False:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name} was not acknowledged by the engine", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE)
+    render(result if result is not None else {"command": name, "account": scope, "status": "acknowledged"}, args.format)
+    return 0
+
+
+def run_operator_command(name: str, args: Any) -> int:
+    if name in {"close", "close-all", "flatten"}:
+        return _engine_command(name, args)
+    service = _service(name)
+    operation = {
+        "positions": "positions", "orders": "orders", "balance": "balance", "budget": "budget",
+        "reconcile": "reconcile", "stop-status": "stop_status", "stops-audit": "stops_audit",
+        "trail-status": "trail_status", "trail-history": "trail_history", "trail-policy-show": "trail_policy_show",
+        "trail-policy-set": "trail_policy_set", "trail-reconcile": "trail_reconcile",
+        "entry-limits": "entry_limits", "entry-limits-reset": "entry_limits_reset", "cooldown-status": "cooldown_status",
+    }[name]
+    method = getattr(service, operation, None)
+    if method is None:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name}: service operation is unavailable")
+    try:
+        result = _call(method, _scope(args), args)
+    except (ConnectionError, TimeoutError) as exc:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name}: service unreachable: {exc}", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE) from exc
+    except Exception as exc:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name}: {exc}") from exc
+    if getattr(result, "ok", True) is False:
+        render(result, args.format)
+        return EXIT_UNHEALTHY
+    render(result, args.format)
+    return 0

+from __future__ import annotations

+
+

+    yield
+    cli_commands.CLI_SERVICES.clear()
+    position_commands.POSITION_SERVICES.clear()

+    for command in cli.CANONICAL_COMMANDS:
+        assert parser.parse_args([command]).subcommand == command
+
+
+def test_stop_does_not_cancel_or_close(capsys):
+    class Lifecycle:
+        def __init__(self): self.calls = []
+        def stop_engine(self, **kwargs): self.calls.append("stop"); return {"stopped": True}
+        def cancel(self, *a): self.calls.append("cancel")
+        def close(self, *a): self.calls.append("close")
+    lifecycle = Lifecycle()
+    cli_commands.CLI_SERVICES["stop"] = lifecycle
+    assert cli.main(["stop"]) == 0
+    assert lifecycle.calls == ["stop"]
+    assert "remain broker-protected" in capsys.readouterr().out
+
+

+    class EntryControls:
+        def __init__(self): self.calls = []
+        def pause_entries(self, **kwargs): self.calls.append("entries-paused")
+    controls = EntryControls()
+    cli_commands.CLI_SERVICES["entry-controls"] = controls
+    assert cli.main(["pause"]) == 0
+    assert controls.calls == ["entries-paused"]
+
+
+def test_live_close_confirmation_guard_then_env_override(monkeypatch, capsys):
+    class Engine:
+        calls = []
+        def is_online(self, scope): self.calls.append(("online", scope)); return True
+        def send_and_wait(self, name, **kwargs): self.calls.append((name, kwargs["scope"])); return {"ack": True}
+    engine = Engine()
+    position_commands.POSITION_SERVICES["engine_control"] = engine
+    assert cli.main(["--account", "LIVE:acct", "close", "AAPL"]) == 3
+    assert engine.calls == []
+    monkeypatch.setenv("CONFIRM_LIVE", "YES")
+    assert cli.main(["--account", "LIVE:acct", "close", "AAPL"]) == 0
+    assert engine.calls == [("online", "LIVE:acct"), ("close", "LIVE:acct")]
+
+
+def test_risk_reducing_controls_need_no_live_confirmation():
+    calls = []
+    controls = types.SimpleNamespace(
+        disable_entries=lambda **kw: calls.append(("disable", kw["scope"])),
+        disable_live=lambda **kw: calls.append(("live-disable", kw["scope"])),
+    )
+    cli_commands.CLI_SERVICES["entry-controls"] = controls
+    cli_commands.CLI_SERVICES["live-disable"] = controls
+    assert cli.main(["--account", "LIVE:acct", "entries-disable"]) == 0
+    assert cli.main(["--account", "LIVE:acct", "live-disable"]) != 3
+    assert calls[0] == ("disable", "LIVE:acct")
+
+
+def test_offline_close_does_not_write_queued_intent(tmp_path):
+    db = sqlite3.connect(tmp_path / "operator.db")
+    db.execute("create table intents (id integer primary key)")
+    class Engine:
+        def is_online(self, scope): return False
+        def send_and_wait(self, *a, **kw): raise AssertionError("must not send")
+    position_commands.POSITION_SERVICES["engine_control"] = Engine()
+    assert cli.main(["close", "AAPL"]) == 4
+    assert db.execute("select count(*) from intents").fetchone()[0] == 0
+    assert FrozenClock().now().year == 2026
+
+
+def test_live_start_runs_preflight_and_refuses_failure():
+    calls = []
+    class Preflight:
+        def run(self, **kwargs): calls.append("preflight"); return False
+    cli_commands.CLI_SERVICES["live-preflight"] = Preflight()
+    cli_commands.CLI_SERVICES["live-start"] = lambda **kwargs: calls.append("start")
+    assert cli.main(["--account", "LIVE:acct", "--confirm-live", "YES", "live-start"]) == 3
+    assert calls == ["preflight"]
+
+
+def test_account_scope_passed_to_service():
+    seen = []
+    cli_commands.CLI_SERVICES["status"] = lambda **kwargs: seen.append(kwargs["scope"]) or {"ok": True}
+    assert cli.main(["--account", "PAPER:subaccount", "status"]) == 0
+    assert seen == ["PAPER:subaccount"]
+
+
+def test_json_decimal_is_string_and_account_identifier_masked(capsys):
+    cli_commands.CLI_SERVICES["status"] = lambda **kwargs: {
+        "cash": Decimal("12.30"), "account_id": "private-account"
+    }
+    assert cli.main(["status", "--format", "json"]) == 0
+    output = json.loads(capsys.readouterr().out)
+    assert output == {"account_id": "***", "cash": "12.30"}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["signals", "evaluations", "events", "logs", "health"])
+def test_history_commands_are_lazily_routed(monkeypatch, name):
+    module = types.ModuleType("mike_trade.controls.history_commands")
+    calls = []
+    module.run_history_command = lambda command, args: calls.append((command, args.account)) or 0
+    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "mike_trade.controls.history_commands", module)
+    assert cli.main([name]) == 0
+    assert calls == [(name, "SHADOW:default")]

+"""Thin lifecycle, configuration, provider, strategy, mode and reporting CLI routes.
+
+Concrete application services are injected through ``CLI_SERVICES`` by the
+composition root. This module owns argument routing and safety checks only.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from typing import Any
+
+from mike_trade.cli import EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE, EXIT_REFUSED, EXIT_UNHEALTHY, require_live_confirmation, render
+
+CLI_SERVICES: dict[str, Any] = {}
+
+
+class OperatorCommandError(RuntimeError):
+    def __init__(self, message: str, exit_code: int = EXIT_UNHEALTHY):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.exit_code = exit_code
+
+
+def _scope(args: Any) -> str:
+    return str(args.account)
+
+
+def _service(name: str) -> Any:
+    service = CLI_SERVICES.get(name)
+    if service is None:
+        raise OperatorCommandError(f"{name}: service is not configured")
+    return service
+
+
+def _invoke(service: Any, operation: str, args: Any) -> Any:
+    method = getattr(service, operation, None)
+    if method is None and callable(service):
+        method = service
+    if method is None:
+        raise OperatorCommandError(f"{operation}: service operation is unavailable")
+    try:
+        return method(scope=_scope(args), scenario=args.scenario, args=args)
+    except TypeError:
+        try:
+            return method(_scope(args), args)
+        except TypeError:
+            return method(_scope(args))
+
+
+def _run_report(name: str, args: Any) -> Any | None:
+    """Use the s.1/s.2 reporting builders against an injected, scope-bound source."""
+    provider = CLI_SERVICES.get("reporting-context")
+    if provider is None:
+        return None
+    context = provider(scope=_scope(args), scenario=args.scenario, args=args)
+    source = context["source"]
+    report_filter = context["report_filter"]
+    from dataclasses import replace
+    from mike_trade.reporting import metrics
+
+    period = getattr(args, "period", "all")
+    report_filter = replace(report_filter, period=period)
+    if name == "report-symbol":
+        report_filter = replace(report_filter, symbol=args.symbol_or_name)
+    elif name == "report-strategy":
+        report_filter = replace(report_filter, buy_strategy=args.symbol_or_name)
+    if name in {"report-pairs"}:
+        return metrics.summarize_by_pair(source, report_filter)
+    if name in {"report-symbol"}:
+        return metrics.summarize_by_symbol(source, report_filter)
+    if name in {"report-strategy"}:
+        return metrics.summarize_by_strategy(source, report_filter)
+    if name == "report-comparison":
+        compare = context.get("compare_accounts")
+        if compare is None:
+            raise OperatorCommandError("comparison reporting requires two explicitly scoped accounts")

+

+"""Thin account-scoped position and risk-control routes.
+
+The engine owns serialized command acknowledgement and order coordination.
+The CLI refuses executable actions before submission when its heartbeat is
+missing or stale, so no future intent is queued offline.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from typing import Any
+
+from mike_trade.cli import EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE, EXIT_REFUSED, EXIT_UNHEALTHY, render
+
+POSITION_SERVICES: dict[str, Any] = {}
+
+
+class PositionCommandError(RuntimeError):
+    def __init__(self, message: str, exit_code: int = EXIT_UNHEALTHY):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.exit_code = exit_code
+
+
+def _scope(args: Any) -> str:
+    return str(args.account)
+
+
+def _service(name: str) -> Any:
+    value = POSITION_SERVICES.get(name)
+    if value is None:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name}: service is not configured")
+    return value
+
+
+def _call(method: Any, scope: str, args: Any) -> Any:
+    try:
+        return method(scope=scope, scenario=args.scenario, args=args)
+    except TypeError:
+        try:
+            return method(scope, args)
+        except TypeError:
+            return method(scope)
+
+
+def _engine_command(name: str, args: Any) -> int:
+    engine = _service("engine_control")
+    scope = _scope(args)
+    online = getattr(engine, "is_online", None) or getattr(engine, "is_engine_online", None)
+    if online is None or not bool(online(scope)):
+        print(f"{name} refused: engine heartbeat is absent or stale for the selected account; no command was queued.", file=sys.stderr)
+        return EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE
+    send = getattr(engine, "send_and_wait", None) or getattr(engine, "submit_and_wait", None) or getattr(engine, "send_control", None)
+    if send is None:
+        raise PositionCommandError("engine control channel is unavailable", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE)
+    payload = {"symbol": getattr(args, "symbol_or_name", None), "reason": args.reason,
+               "live_confirmed": getattr(args, "confirm_live", None) == "YES"}
+    try:
+        result = send(name, scope=scope, payload=payload, timeout=getattr(engine, "ack_timeout", 30))
+    except (ConnectionError, TimeoutError) as exc:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name} acknowledgement unavailable: {exc}", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE) from exc
+    if result is False or getattr(result, "acknowledged", True) is False:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name} was not acknowledged by the engine", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE)
+    render(result if result is not None else {"command": name, "account": scope, "status": "acknowledged"}, args.format)
+    return 0
+
+
+def run_operator_command(name: str, args: Any) -> int:
+    if name in {"close", "close-all", "flatten"}:
+        return _engine_command(name, args)
+    service = _service(name)
+    operation = {
+        "positions": "positions", "orders": "orders", "balance": "balance", "budget": "budget",
+        "reconcile": "reconcile", "stop-status": "stop_status", "stops-audit": "stops_audit",
+        "trail-status": "trail_status", "trail-history": "trail_history", "trail-policy-show": "trail_policy_show",
+        "trail-policy-set": "trail_policy_set", "trail-reconcile": "trail_reconcile",
+        "entry-limits": "entry_limits", "entry-limits-reset": "entry_limits_reset", "cooldown-status": "cooldown_status",
+    }[name]
+    method = getattr(service, operation, None)
+    if method is None:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name}: service operation is unavailable")
+    try:
+        result = _call(method, _scope(args), args)
+    except (ConnectionError, TimeoutError) as exc:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name}: service unreachable: {exc}", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE) from exc
+    except Exception as exc:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name}: {exc}") from exc
+    if getattr(result, "ok", True) is False:
+        render(result, args.format)
+        return EXIT_UNHEALTHY
+    render(result, args.format)
+    return 0

+    if service is None:
+        raise OperatorCommandError(f"{name}: service is not configured")
+    return service
+
+
+def _invoke(service: Any, operation: str, args: Any) -> Any:
+    method = getattr(service, operation, None)
+    if method is None and callable(service):
+        method = service
+    if method is None:
+        raise OperatorCommandError(f"{operation}: service operation is unavailable")
+    try:
+        return method(scope=_scope(args), scenario=args.scenario, args=args)
+    except TypeError:
+        try:
+            return method(_scope(args), args)
+        except TypeError:
+            return method(_scope(args))
+

+"""Thin account-scoped position and risk-control routes.
+
+The engine owns serialized command acknowledgement and order coordination.
+The CLI refuses executable actions before submission when its heartbeat is
+missing or stale, so no future intent is queued offline.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from typing import Any
+
+from mike_trade.cli import EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE, EXIT_REFUSED, EXIT_UNHEALTHY, render
+
+POSITION_SERVICES: dict[str, Any] = {}
+
+
+class PositionCommandError(RuntimeError):
+    def __init__(self, message: str, exit_code: int = EXIT_UNHEALTHY):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.exit_code = exit_code
+
+
+def _scope(args: Any) -> str:
+    return str(args.account)
+
+
+def _service(name: str) -> Any:
+    value = POSITION_SERVICES.get(name)
+    if value is None:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name}: service is not configured")
+    return value
+
+
+def _call(method: Any, scope: str, args: Any) -> Any:
+    try:
+        return method(scope=scope, scenario=args.scenario, args=args)
+    except TypeError:
+        try:
+            return method(scope, args)
+        except TypeError:
+            return method(scope)
+
+
+def _engine_command(name: str, args: Any) -> int:
+    engine = _service("engine_control")
+    scope = _scope(args)
+    online = getattr(engine, "is_online", None) or getattr(engine, "is_engine_online", None)
+    if online is None or not bool(online(scope)):
+        print(f"{name} refused: engine heartbeat is absent or stale for the selected account; no command was queued.", file=sys.stderr)
+        return EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE
+    send = getattr(engine, "send_and_wait", None) or getattr(engine, "submit_and_wait", None) or getattr(engine, "send_control", None)
+    if send is None:
+        raise PositionCommandError("engine control channel is unavailable", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE)
+    payload = {"symbol": getattr(args, "symbol_or_name", None), "reason": args.reason,
+               "live_confirmed": getattr(args, "confirm_live", None) == "YES"}
+    try:
+        result = send(name, scope=scope, payload=payload, timeout=getattr(engine, "ack_timeout", 30))
+    except (ConnectionError, TimeoutError) as exc:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name} acknowledgement unavailable: {exc}", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE) from exc
+    if result is False or getattr(result, "acknowledged", True) is False:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name} was not acknowledged by the engine", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE)
+    render(result if result is not None else {"command": name, "account": scope, "status": "acknowledged"}, args.format)
+    return 0
+
+
+def run_operator_command(name: str, args: Any) -> int:
+    if name in {"close", "close-all", "flatten"}:
+        return _engine_command(name, args)
+    service = _service(name)
+    operation = {
+        "positions": "positions", "orders": "orders", "balance": "balance", "budget": "budget",
+        "reconcile": "reconcile", "stop-status": "stop_status", "stops-audit": "stops_audit",
+        "trail-status": "trail_status", "trail-history": "trail_history", "trail-policy-show": "trail_policy_show",
+        "trail-policy-set": "trail_policy_set", "trail-reconcile": "trail_reconcile",
+        "entry-limits": "entry_limits", "entry-limits-reset": "entry_limits_reset", "cooldown-status": "cooldown_status",
+    }[name]
+    method = getattr(service, operation, None)
+    if method is None:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name}: service operation is unavailable")
+    try:
+        result = _call(method, _scope(args), args)
+    except (ConnectionError, TimeoutError) as exc:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name}: service unreachable: {exc}", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE) from exc
+    except Exception as exc:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name}: {exc}") from exc
+    if getattr(result, "ok", True) is False:
+        render(result, args.format)
+        return EXIT_UNHEALTHY
+    render(result, args.format)
+    return 0

+from __future__ import annotations
+

+
+

+    yield

+    position_commands.POSITION_SERVICES.clear()

+    for command in cli.CANONICAL_COMMANDS:
+        assert parser.parse_args([command]).subcommand == command
+
+
+def test_stop_does_not_cancel_or_close(capsys):
+    class Lifecycle:
+        def __init__(self): self.calls = []
+        def stop_engine(self, **kwargs): self.calls.append("stop"); return {"stopped": True}
+        def cancel(self, *a): self.calls.append("cancel")
+        def close(self, *a): self.calls.append("close")
+    lifecycle = Lifecycle()
+    cli_commands.CLI_SERVICES["stop"] = lifecycle
+    assert cli.main(["stop"]) == 0
+    assert lifecycle.calls == ["stop"]
+    assert "remain broker-protected" in capsys.readouterr().out
+
+
+def test_pause_only_changes_entry_eligibility():
+    class EntryControls:
+        def __init__(self): self.calls = []
+        def pause_entries(self, **kwargs): self.calls.append("entries-paused")
+    controls = EntryControls()
+    cli_commands.CLI_SERVICES["entry-controls"] = controls
+    assert cli.main(["pause"]) == 0
+    assert controls.calls == ["entries-paused"]
+
+
+def test_live_close_confirmation_guard_then_env_override(monkeypatch, capsys):
+    class Engine:
+        calls = []
+        def is_online(self, scope): self.calls.append(("online", scope)); return True
+        def send_and_wait(self, name, **kwargs): self.calls.append((name, kwargs["scope"])); return {"ack": True}
+    engine = Engine()
+    position_commands.POSITION_SERVICES["engine_control"] = engine
+    assert cli.main(["--account", "LIVE:acct", "close", "AAPL"]) == 3
+    assert engine.calls == []
+    monkeypatch.setenv("CONFIRM_LIVE", "YES")
+    assert cli.main(["--account", "LIVE:acct", "close", "AAPL"]) == 0
+    assert engine.calls == [("online", "LIVE:acct"), ("close", "LIVE:acct")]
+
+
+def test_risk_reducing_controls_need_no_live_confirmation():
+    calls = []
+    controls = types.SimpleNamespace(
+        disable_entries=lambda **kw: calls.append(("disable", kw["scope"])),
+        disable_live=lambda **kw: calls.append(("live-disable", kw["scope"])),
+    )
+    cli_commands.CLI_SERVICES["entry-controls"] = controls
+    cli_commands.CLI_SERVICES["live-disable"] = controls
+    assert cli.main(["--account", "LIVE:acct", "entries-disable"]) == 0
+    assert cli.main(["--account", "LIVE:acct", "live-disable"]) != 3
+    assert calls[0] == ("disable", "LIVE:acct")
+
+
+def test_offline_close_does_not_write_queued_intent(tmp_path):
+    db = sqlite3.connect(tmp_path / "operator.db")
+    db.execute("create table intents (id integer primary key)")
+    class Engine:
+        def is_online(self, scope): return False
+        def send_and_wait(self, *a, **kw): raise AssertionError("must not send")

+def test_live_start_runs_preflight_and_refuses_failure():

+def test_history_commands_are_lazily_routed(monkeypatch, name):

+"""Thin lifecycle, configuration, provider, strategy, mode and reporting CLI routes.
+
+Concrete application services are injected through ``CLI_SERVICES`` by the
+composition root. This module owns argument routing and safety checks only.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from typing import Any
+
+from mike_trade.cli import EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE, EXIT_REFUSED, EXIT_UNHEALTHY, require_live_confirmation, render
+
+CLI_SERVICES: dict[str, Any] = {}

+class OperatorCommandError(RuntimeError):
+    def __init__(self, message: str, exit_code: int = EXIT_UNHEALTHY):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.exit_code = exit_code
+
+
+def _scope(args: Any) -> str:
+    return str(args.account)
+
+
+def _service(name: str) -> Any:
+    service = CLI_SERVICES.get(name)
+    if service is None:
+        raise OperatorCommandError(f"{name}: service is not configured")
+    return service
+
+
+def _invoke(service: Any, operation: str, args: Any) -> Any:
+    method = getattr(service, operation, None)
+    if method is None and callable(service):
+        method = service
+    if method is None:
+        raise OperatorCommandError(f"{operation}: service operation is unavailable")
+    try:
+        return method(scope=_scope(args), scenario=args.scenario, args=args)
+    except TypeError:
+        try:
+            return method(_scope(args), args)
+        except TypeError:
+            return method(_scope(args))
+
+
+def _run_report(name: str, args: Any) -> Any | None:
+    """Use the s.1/s.2 reporting builders against an injected, scope-bound source."""
+    provider = CLI_SERVICES.get("reporting-context")
+    if provider is None:
+        return None
+    context = provider(scope=_scope(args), scenario=args.scenario, args=args)
+    source = context["source"]
+    report_filter = context["report_filter"]
+    from dataclasses import replace
+    from mike_trade.reporting import metrics
+
+    period = getattr(args, "period", "all")
+    report_filter = replace(report_filter, period=period)
+    if name == "report-symbol":
+        report_filter = replace(report_filter, symbol=args.symbol_or_name)
+    elif name == "report-strategy":
+        report_filter = replace(report_filter, buy_strategy=args.symbol_or_name)
+    if name in {"report-pairs"}:
+        return metrics.summarize_by_pair(source, report_filter)
+    if name in {"report-symbol"}:
+        return metrics.summarize_by_symbol(source, report_filter)
+    if name in {"report-strategy"}:
+        return metrics.summarize_by_strategy(source, report_filter)
+    if name == "report-comparison":
+        compare = context.get("compare_accounts")
+        if compare is None:
+            raise OperatorCommandError("comparison reporting requires two explicitly scoped accounts")
+        return metrics.compare_accounts(source, compare, report_filter)
+    return metrics.build_trade_cycles(source, report_filter)
+
+

+            "entries-disable": "disable_entries", "entries-enable": "enable_entries",

+        "symbols-enable": "enable_symbols", "symbols-disable": "disable_symbols",
+        "dashboard": "dashboard_status", "dashboard-start": "start_dashboard", "dashboard-stop": "stop_dashboard", "dashboard-health": "dashboard_health",
+        "shadow-start": "start_shadow", "shadow-stop": "stop_shadow", "shadow-list": "list_scenarios", "shadow-create": "create_scenario", "shadow-reset": "reset_scenario",
+        "paper-start": "start_paper", "paper-stop": "stop_paper", "paper-status": "paper_status",
+        "live-preflight": "run", "live-enable": "enable_live", "live-start": "start_live", "live-disable": "disable_live",
+        "report": "report", "report-daily": "report_daily", "report-symbol": "report_symbol", "report-strategy": "report_strategy",
+        "report-pairs": "report_pairs", "report-shadow": "report_shadow", "report-comparison": "report_comparison", "report-export": "report_export",
+        "backtest": "run_backtest", "backtest-status": "backtest_status", "backtest-report": "backtest_report", "backtest-list": "backtest_list",
+        "cache-status": "cache_status", "cache-refresh": "cache_refresh", "db-check": "db_check", "db-backup": "db_backup", "db-restore-dry-run": "db_restore_dry_run",
+        "service-install": "service_install", "service-uninstall": "service_uninstall", "service-status": "service_status",
+    }[name]
+    try:
+        result = _invoke(service, operation, args)

+        raise OperatorCommandError(f"{name}: service unreachable: {exc}", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE) from exc
+    except Exception as exc:

+"""Thin account-scoped position and risk-control routes.
+
+The engine owns serialized command acknowledgement and order coordination.
+The CLI refuses executable actions before submission when its heartbeat is
+missing or stale, so no future intent is queued offline.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from typing import Any
+
+from mike_trade.cli import EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE, EXIT_REFUSED, EXIT_UNHEALTHY, render
+
+POSITION_SERVICES: dict[str, Any] = {}
+
+
+class PositionCommandError(RuntimeError):
+    def __init__(self, message: str, exit_code: int = EXIT_UNHEALTHY):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.exit_code = exit_code
+
+
+def _scope(args: Any) -> str:
+    return str(args.account)
+
+
+def _service(name: str) -> Any:
+    value = POSITION_SERVICES.get(name)
+    if value is None:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name}: service is not configured")
+    return value
+
+
+def _call(method: Any, scope: str, args: Any) -> Any:
+    try:
+        return method(scope=scope, scenario=args.scenario, args=args)
+    except TypeError:
+        try:
+            return method(scope, args)
+        except TypeError:
+            return method(scope)
+
+
+def _engine_command(name: str, args: Any) -> int:
+    engine = _service("engine_control")
+    scope = _scope(args)
+    online = getattr(engine, "is_online", None) or getattr(engine, "is_engine_online", None)
+    if online is None or not bool(online(scope)):
+        print(f"{name} refused: engine heartbeat is absent or stale for the selected account; no command was queued.", file=sys.stderr)
+        return EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE
+    send = getattr(engine, "send_and_wait", None) or getattr(engine, "submit_and_wait", None) or getattr(engine, "send_control", None)
+    if send is None:
+        raise PositionCommandError("engine control channel is unavailable", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE)
+    payload = {"symbol": getattr(args, "symbol_or_name", None), "reason": args.reason,
+               "live_confirmed": getattr(args, "confirm_live", None) == "YES"}
+    try:
+        result = send(name, scope=scope, payload=payload, timeout=getattr(engine, "ack_timeout", 30))
+    except (ConnectionError, TimeoutError) as exc:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name} acknowledgement unavailable: {exc}", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE) from exc
+    if result is False or getattr(result, "acknowledged", True) is False:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name} was not acknowledged by the engine", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE)
+    render(result if result is not None else {"command": name, "account": scope, "status": "acknowledged"}, args.format)
+    return 0
+
+
+def run_operator_command(name: str, args: Any) -> int:
+    if name in {"close", "close-all", "flatten"}:
+        return _engine_command(name, args)
+    service = _service(name)
+    operation = {
+        "positions": "positions", "orders": "orders", "balance": "balance", "budget": "budget",
+        "reconcile": "reconcile", "stop-status": "stop_status", "stops-audit": "stops_audit",
+        "trail-status": "trail_status", "trail-history": "trail_history", "trail-policy-show": "trail_policy_show",
+        "trail-policy-set": "trail_policy_set", "trail-reconcile": "trail_reconcile",
+        "entry-limits": "entry_limits", "entry-limits-reset": "entry_limits_reset", "cooldown-status": "cooldown_status",
+    }[name]
+    method = getattr(service, operation, None)
+    if method is None:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name}: service operation is unavailable")
+    try:
+        result = _call(method, _scope(args), args)
+    except (ConnectionError, TimeoutError) as exc:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name}: service unreachable: {exc}", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE) from exc
+    except Exception as exc:
+        raise PositionCommandError(f"{name}: {exc}") from exc
+    if getattr(result, "ok", True) is False:
+        render(result, args.format)
+        return EXIT_UNHEALTHY
+    render(result, args.format)
+    return 0

+"""Thin lifecycle, configuration, provider, strategy, mode and reporting CLI routes.
+
+Concrete application services are injected through ``CLI_SERVICES`` by the
+composition root. This module owns argument routing and safety checks only.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from typing import Any
+
+from mike_trade.cli import EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE, EXIT_REFUSED, EXIT_UNHEALTHY, require_live_confirmation, render
+
+CLI_SERVICES: dict[str, Any] = {}
+
+
+class OperatorCommandError(RuntimeError):
+    def __init__(self, message: str, exit_code: int = EXIT_UNHEALTHY):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.exit_code = exit_code
+
+
+def _scope(args: Any) -> str:
+    return str(args.account)
+
+
+def _service(name: str) -> Any:
+    service = CLI_SERVICES.get(name)
+    if service is None:
+        raise OperatorCommandError(f"{name}: service is not configured")
+    return service
+
+
+def _invoke(service: Any, operation: str, args: Any) -> Any:
+    method = getattr(service, operation, None)
+    if method is None and callable(service):
+        method = service
+    if method is None:
+        raise OperatorCommandError(f"{operation}: service operation is unavailable")
+    try:
+        return method(scope=_scope(args), scenario=args.scenario, args=args)
+    except TypeError:
+        try:
+            return method(_scope(args), args)
+        except TypeError:
+            return method(_scope(args))
+
+
+def _run_report(name: str, args: Any) -> Any | None:
+    """Use the s.1/s.2 reporting builders against an injected, scope-bound source."""
+    provider = CLI_SERVICES.get("reporting-context")
+    if provider is None:
+        return None
+    context = provider(scope=_scope(args), scenario=args.scenario, args=args)
+    source = context["source"]
+    report_filter = context["report_filter"]
+    from dataclasses import replace
+    from mike_trade.reporting import metrics
+
+    period = getattr(args, "period", "all")
+    report_filter = replace(report_filter, period=period)
+    if name == "report-symbol":
+        report_filter = replace(report_filter, symbol=args.symbol_or_name)
+    elif name == "report-strategy":
+        report_filter = replace(report_filter, buy_strategy=args.symbol_or_name)
+    if name in {"report-pairs"}:
+        return metrics.summarize_by_pair(source, report_filter)
+    if name in {"report-symbol"}:
+        return metrics.summarize_by_symbol(source, report_filter)
+    if name in {"report-strategy"}:
+        return metrics.summarize_by_strategy(source, report_filter)
+    if name == "report-comparison":
+        compare = context.get("compare_accounts")
+        if compare is None:
+            raise OperatorCommandError("comparison reporting requires two explicitly scoped accounts")
+        return metrics.compare_accounts(source, compare, report_filter)
+    return metrics.build_trade_cycles(source, report_filter)
+
+
+def run_operator_command(name: str, args: Any) -> int:
+    if name in {"pause", "resume", "pause-symbol", "resume-symbol", "entries-disable", "entries-enable"}:
+        controls = _service("entry-controls")
+        # These controls affect eligibility of new entries only. They do not
+        # stop fill handling, protection, trailing management or reconciliation.
+        method_name = {
+            "pause": "pause_entries", "resume": "resume_entries",
+            "pause-symbol": "pause_symbol_entries", "resume-symbol": "resume_symbol_entries",
+            "entries-disable": "disable_entries", "entries-enable": "enable_entries",
+        }[name]
+        result = _invoke(controls, method_name, args)
+        render(result if result is not None else {"command": name, "scope": _scope(args), "effect": "new entries only"}, args.format)
+        return 0
+    if name in {"live-enable", "live-start"}:
+        try:
+            result = _invoke(_service("live-preflight"), "run", args)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            print(f"Live preflight failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
+            return EXIT_REFUSED
+        if result is False or getattr(result, "ok", True) is False:
+            print("Live preflight failed; operation refused.", file=sys.stderr)
+            return EXIT_REFUSED
+    if name == "stop":
+        result = _invoke(_service(name), "stop_engine", args)
+        print("Engine stopped. Open positions remain broker-protected.")
+        if result is not None:
+            render(result, args.format)
+        return 0
+    if name.startswith("report"):
+        try:
+            report = _run_report(name, args)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            raise OperatorCommandError(f"{name}: {exc}") from exc
+        if report is not None:
+            if name == "report-export":
+                from mike_trade.reporting.export import export_json
+                export_json(report, "trade_cycles", getattr(args, "output_path", None))
+                print(f"Exported report to {args.output_path}" if args.output_path else "Report export rendered.")
+            else:
+                render(report, args.format)
+            return 0
+    service = _service(name)
+    # Explicit operation mapping avoids converting CLI names into business logic.
+    operation = {
+        "start": "start_engine", "restart": "restart_engine", "status": "status",
+        "doctor": "doctor", "config-show": "show_config", "providers": "list_providers",
+        "provider-check": "check_provider", "broker-check": "check_broker", "data-check": "check_data",
+        "strategies": "list_strategies", "strategy-info": "strategy_info", "strategy-check": "check_strategy",
+        "strategy-enable": "enable_strategy", "strategy-disable": "disable_strategy", "strategy-set": "set_strategy",
+        "symbols": "list_symbols", "symbols-add": "add_symbols", "symbols-remove": "remove_symbols",
+        "symbols-enable": "enable_symbols", "symbols-disable": "disable_symbols",
+        "dashboard": "dashboard_status", "dashboard-start": "start_dashboard", "dashboard-stop": "stop_dashboard", "dashboard-health": "dashboard_health",
+        "shadow-start": "start_shadow", "shadow-stop": "stop_shadow", "shadow-list": "list_scenarios", "shadow-create": "create_scenario", "shadow-reset": "reset_scenario",
+        "paper-start": "start_paper", "paper-stop": "stop_paper", "paper-status": "paper_status",
+        "live-preflight": "run", "live-enable": "enable_live", "live-start": "start_live", "live-disable": "disable_live",
+        "report": "report", "report-daily": "report_daily", "report-symbol": "report_symbol", "report-strategy": "report_strategy",
+        "report-pairs": "report_pairs", "report-shadow": "report_shadow", "report-comparison": "report_comparison", "report-export": "report_export",
+        "backtest": "run_backtest", "backtest-status": "backtest_status", "backtest-report": "backtest_report", "backtest-list": "backtest_list",
+        "cache-status": "cache_status", "cache-refresh": "cache_refresh", "db-check": "db_check", "db-backup": "db_backup", "db-restore-dry-run": "db_restore_dry_run",
+        "service-install": "service_install", "service-uninstall": "service_uninstall", "service-status": "service_status",
+    }[name]
+    try:
+        result = _invoke(service, operation, args)
+    except (ConnectionError, TimeoutError) as exc:
+        raise OperatorCommandError(f"{name}: service unreachable: {exc}", EXIT_ENGINE_OFFLINE) from exc
+    except Exception as exc:
+        raise OperatorCommandError(f"{name}: {exc}") from exc
+    if name.endswith("-check") or name in {"doctor", "live-preflight", "dashboard-health", "db-check"}:
+        if result is False or getattr(result, "ok", True) is False:
+            render(result, args.format)
+            return EXIT_UNHEALTHY
+    render(result, args.format)
+    return 0
